Title: Submit User Details Form with valid name and phone number
Preconditions: App is running and user has navigated to the User Details Form page via the sidebar
Steps: 1. Open the app | 2. Click "User Details Form" in the sidebar navigation | 3. Enter a valid name in the Name field | 4. Enter a valid phone number in the Phone Number field | 5. Click Submit
Expected Result: A green success message is shown: "Thank you, John Doe! Your details have been submitted."

Title: Navigate from Home to Contact Us to User Details Form and submit
Preconditions: App is running with default Home page loaded
Steps: 1. Verify Home page loads by default | 2. Select "Contact Us" in the sidebar and verify address, email, and phone details render | 3. Select "User Details Form" in the sidebar (positioned after Contact Us) | 4. Fill in Name and Phone Number | 5. Click Submit
Expected Result: User can move sequentially from Home -> Contact Us -> User Details Form, and the form submits successfully showing a success message

Title: Submit phone number at minimum and maximum allowed length boundaries
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number with exactly 7 characters (minimum allowed) | 3. Click Submit | 4. Repeat with a phone number of exactly 15 characters (maximum allowed)
Test Data: Name: Amit Rao; Phone Number: 1234567 (7 chars) and Phone Number: 123456789012345 (15 chars)
Expected Result: Both the 7-character and 15-character phone numbers are accepted and the form submits successfully with a success message

Title: Name field accepts names containing spaces and is trimmed correctly
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a name with leading/trailing spaces | 2. Enter a valid phone number | 3. Click Submit
Expected Result: Form submits successfully and the success message shows the trimmed name: "Thank you, Sarah Khan! Your details have been submitted."

Title: Submit form with empty Name and empty Phone Number
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Leave the Name field empty | 2. Leave the Phone Number field empty | 3. Click Submit
Expected Result: Two error messages are displayed: "Name is required." and "Phone number is required."

Title: Submit form with an invalid phone number format
Preconditions: User is on the User Details Form page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number containing invalid characters or an invalid length | 3. Click Submit
Test Data: Name: Ravi Kumar; Phone Number: abc123
Expected Result: An error message is displayed: "Please enter a valid phone number."
